scope: Mid-patch changes and availability rules; annotations, not blindly applied simulator constants

changes.subject: Combat phase timing
changes.change: Combat arrival and departure are each one second shorter in 18.4.

changes.subject: Camille
changes.change: Three-star ability AD ratio becomes 400%, from 375%.

changes.subject: Alistar
changes.change: Ability heal becomes 230/300/400 AP; damage becomes 180/270/420 AP.

changes.subject: Gromp AD form
changes.change: Base AD becomes 50 and attack speed becomes 0.75.

changes.subject: Warwick
changes.change: Spell damage becomes 230/345/535% AD; spell healing becomes 25%.

changes.subject: Nidalee
changes.change: Armor penetration follows the corrected tooltip.

changes.subject: Abandon Ship
changes.change: Offer window is the first two seconds of planning.

changes.subject: Stat Boosters
changes.change: Armor and magic resist bonuses become 8; attack speed bonus becomes 6%.

changes.subject: Healing Pool
changes.change: Requires at least 10 missing HP to appear.

changes.subject: Search Party
changes.change: Cost tiers become one gold and zero gold.

changes.subject: Thingamajig
changes.change: Mana regeneration boosters become less likely; exact frequency unpublished.

changes.subject: Heart of Steel
changes.change: Temporarily disabled while a bug is investigated.

changes.subject: Coven Acolyte and Dark Ritual
changes.change: Combined limit is one player per lobby.

changes.subject: Chosen of the Sun
changes.change: Limited to one player per lobby.

changes.subject: Champion abilities
changes.change: Some disappearing-before-damage abilities were fixed; exact affected champion list unpublished.
